prompts.title: 항해 풍경과 주변 요소
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first environment moodboard for the original game Cloudstitch, a warm handcrafted fantasy airship adventure.
Create a beautiful high-resolution LANDSCAPE art-direction moodboard, approximately 3:2, carefully composed like a premium illustrated artbook page on warm ivory paper. One large panoramic scene fills the upper two thirds; four elegant specimen illustrations with small number badges sit in an evenly spaced bottom strip. Give generous space to the artwork, crisp silhouettes, rich volumetric forms, selective ink outlines, painterly gouache and watercolor surfaces over convincingly dimensional 3D-like geometry, simple soft shadows, richly layered but restful composition. No photorealism, glossy PBR, plastic, or low-poly placeholder look.
Main scene: an original sky archipelago at morning golden light, abundant irregular floating islands with exposed stratified rock, immense curling tree roots, long trailing plants, varied terraces and heights, pockets of warm wooden human habitation with teal roofs, coral repaired awnings, and brass details. A navigable winding open-sky channel must remain visually clear through the middle. Cream, peach and lavender cloud sea with teal-blue atmosphere; nearby gulls with cream plumage and charcoal wing tips, small swallows far away, wispy wind streamers. Natural ecology and weather are the focus. Include just ONE modest scale-reference airship in the open middle distance: elongated cream stitched fabric balloon with leather bands, a coral repair patch, honey wood boat hull and teal cabin, brass fittings. It must not dominate the environment. One small cascading stream disappearing into a cloud layer, drifting seeds caught in warm light, an asymmetrical wind-shaped tree as memorable landmarks. Foreground, middle islands and pale distant silhouettes show strong depth.
Bottom four specimen vignettes, left to right: 01 a tethered brass-and-wood navigation lantern buoy with generous coral cloth streamers and a small round weight, 02 a broad wind-shaped tree with flowering grass and hanging root mass, 03 a weathered wooden wreck fragment softly overgrown with moss and flowers, 04 a compact cliff-perched brass wind vane with layered teal metal vanes and warm fabric pennants. Depict their distinct functional forms and materials clearly.
Text only: small refined title at top exactly "Cloudstitch"; small subtitle exactly "01 · 항해 풍경"; specimen badges exactly "01", "02", "03", "04". No other text, no UI, no charts, no long captions. All designs must be original. Warm hand-crafted storybook fantasy; slightly extravagant silhouettes, layered volume, characterful asymmetry and lived-in detail. This is painted concept art, not a screenshot or actual implemented game.

prompts.title: 공중섬 실루엣 6종
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: environment design moodboard for original game Cloudstitch.
Create a high-resolution LANDSCAPE 3:2 illustrated artbook concept sheet on lightly textured warm ivory paper, organized into a clean spacious 2-row by 3-column grid with SIX LARGE independent floating island designs. Show each complete island from a consistent slightly elevated three-quarter view with its entire underside and roots visible. Soft pale sky-color vignettes, no thick panel boxes, generous margins, distinct strong silhouettes. Small numeric badges from 01 to 06. No airships except a tiny consistent simple scale silhouette beside each island if helpful; islands are the heroes.
Style: original warm handcrafted fantasy, lavish volume and layered asymmetry, fully dimensional 3D-like forms painted to feel like hand-drawn gouache and watercolor illustration, subtle colored ink contours, warm quiet cel shadows and selective highlights, visible brush textures. NOT flat icons, not photorealistic PBR, not glossy plastic, not repetitive cone rocks with different toppings. Cream/teal/coral/brass/honey wood accents tie human details to the world; nature has varied moss sage and deep green, ocher rock, pale mineral teal.
Six structurally different designs, reading order:
01 ROOT GARDEN: broad almost horizontal mossy terraced rock raft, enormous interwoven warm brown roots curling under it, one large expressive wind-swept flowering tree, small rainwater bowl, thick draping grasses, intimate sanctuary scale.
02 CRESCENT PASS: asymmetrical C-shaped stacked stone island embracing an open air corridor, rocky ledges with hanging grass and one small handmade wind marker, strongly legible empty middle.
03 DOUBLE ARCH: two tall uneven rock towers joined by a natural eroded stone bridge, slanted mineral veins, hanging vines, birds nesting under the arch, elongated vertical silhouette.
04 WATER TERRACES: stepped green shelves wrapping a narrow high rock spine, little pools connected by slender falling streams descending into the cloud layer, hanging roots and a tiny teal roofed cistern shed. Water must not overwhelm the silhouette.
05 WRECK GARDEN: lopsided broken wooden hull ribs caught in a fractured rock cluster, beautiful salvaged brass and rust-dark painted metal among exuberant moss and coral wildflowers, dangling old ropes, historic remains, no active weapons.
06 QUIET STONE TERRACE: wide broken circular stone terrace with an asymmetrical remnant of one simple old watch arch, branching hanging roots, pale wildflowers, one warm lantern and a cloth pennant; no royal insignia, no palace, no story-reveal symbols.
Each should have a noticeably different balance of wide/tall/negative space/structural layers. More flamboyant natural silhouettes with detailed focal areas and quiet broad planes. Soft upper-left warm light; pastel sky cast shadows; no ground plane.
Text only: title exactly "Cloudstitch"; small subtitle exactly "02 · 공중섬"; six badges exactly "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06". No other text or labels, no watermark. These are concept proposals, not six new canonical regions.

prompts.title: 구름과 하늘 생태 8종
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: sky and wildlife environment moodboard for original game Cloudstitch.
Create a polished high-resolution LANDSCAPE 3:2 artbook sheet on warm ivory paper, a generous 2-row by 4-column layout of EIGHT illustrated concept vignettes. Title "Cloudstitch" and subtitle "03 · 구름과 하늘 생태". Each vignette has only its number 01 through 08. No additional words. Top row studies four very different sky/weather forms; bottom row studies four ecological subjects. Keep entire subjects visible, generous panel margins, minimal visual clutter, enough beautiful tactile material detail to reward zooming.
Art direction: original warm handmade fantasy, hand-painted gouache and watercolor over dimensional sculptural 3D-like volume, expressive curved silhouettes, subtle colored linework, simple comfortable cel shadows, layered masses with exaggeration and organic asymmetry. Not photorealism, not hard low-poly surfaces, not plastic. Clouds must be painterly actual atmospheric cloud formations, never cloth sculptures or literal cotton objects. Birds must have recognizable beaks, two wings, two legs, feather groups and clear distinct bodies, no humanoids or decorative mechanical prosthetics. Delicate anatomy, natural airborne poses. Overall warm cream, honey-gold, muted teal, coral details and soft lilac shadows.
Top row:
01 SUNLIT CLOUD BANK: three overlapping cream-peach cumulus volumes with asymmetrical scalloped rounded shapes, lavender undersides and clear empty blue pockets, rich cloud thickness and warm rimlight.
02 LOW MIST RIBBONS: long horizontal translucent pale blue/lavender mist ribbons wrapping around one small muted rock silhouette, gentle morning gradient, calm layered depth with more transparency than 01.
03 RISING AIR COLUMN: elegant vertically curling wispy cloud column around open blue-sky space, a handful of tiny drifting leaves showing upward flow, not a tornado, no violent debris, sunlight catching the edges.
04 STORM FRONT: dense towering charcoal-teal cloud mass with pale violet edges, a hanging rain curtain, tiny restrained branching lightning visible INSIDE the far cloud, a muted warm gap at its edge. Soft contrast, no blinding flash.
Bottom row:
05 HARBOR GULL: large cream-feathered seabird with dark slate wing tips, a warm ocher beak and small feet, one beautiful banking pose above a tiny warm timber mooring post; clear volumetric wing feathers, familiar gentle companion of ports.
06 WIND SWALLOWS: two slender teal-blue-backed swallows with cream-coral throats and forked tails swooping through graceful empty space, smaller agile proportions, recognizable two-wing anatomy on both.
07 RIDGE RAPTOR: one broad-winged tawny hawk gliding with splayed primary feathers, solemn and natural, deep rust-gold and cream plumage; a tiny distant layered rock spire shows its high-altitude habitat.
08 FLOATING SEEDS AND CLIFF NEST: an intimate vignette with a small layered twig nest set in grass on a rock lip, two small naturally feathered adult songbirds perched nearby, long drooping stems and several oversized fluffy milkweed-like seeds riding the breeze; original plant design, storybook ecology.
Make cloud silhouettes and bird flight poses different at thumbnail scale. No giant magical sky creatures, no combat implication, no collectible reward markers, no UI or numerical mechanics. Premium concept moodboard with charming rich details and calm breathing room.
